articles.title: Returns and refunds
articles.body:
You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery. Bikes must be unridden and in their original packaging.

Refunds are paid to the original payment method within 14 days of us receiving the item.

To start a return, reply to your order confirmation with the order number and the items you want to return.

articles.title: Warranty
articles.body:
Frames have a 5-year warranty, all other parts 2 years. The warranty covers defects in material and workmanship, not wear such as brake pads, tyres and chains.

For a warranty claim, send us the order number, a description of the defect and a photo.

articles.title: Shipping
articles.body:
Orders ship within two business days. Bikes are delivered 90% assembled.

You get a tracking link by email as soon as your parcel has left our warehouse.

We ship to Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

articles.title: Brake maintenance
articles.body:
New disc brake pads need to bed in: brake firmly from moderate speed about twenty times. Until then, a little squeaking is normal.

If brakes keep squeaking after bedding in, clean the discs with isopropyl alcohol. Never use oil or lubricant near the brakes.

The Velo City 3 uses resin disc pads of type B01.

articles.title: E-bike batteries
articles.body:
Charge the battery with the original charger only. A full charge takes about four hours.

For long storage, keep the battery at 30 to 60 percent charge in a dry place.

Batteries lose up to 30% of range below 5 °C. Store and charge them indoors in winter, and insert them just before riding.

Error 503 on the display means the motor sensor doesn't respond. Switch the bike off and on; if the error persists, contact support.

articles.title: Finding the right frame size
articles.body:
Measure your inside leg length and multiply it by 0.66 to get the frame size in centimetres.

Between two sizes, choose the smaller one for a sportier position and the larger one for a relaxed position.
